font.serif: Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, "Times New Roman", serif
font.rounded: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
font.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
font.humanist: Seravek, "Gill Sans Nova", Ubuntu, Calibri, "Gill Sans", "Trebuchet MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif

themes.name: default
themes.description: Photo first, the system font of whatever you study on, a black name.

themes.name: serif
themes.description: A green serif name over the usual layout.
themes.extra_css: .name { font-family:Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, "Times New Roman", serif; }

themes.name: field-guide
themes.description: Warm paper, the name in spaced small capitals and an accent rule beside the names.

themes.name: nord
themes.description: The Nord palette: cool Snow Storm paper by day, Polar Night by night, Frost blue accents.

themes.name: slate
themes.description: Cool blue-grey with square corners and the credits in a thin box.
themes.extra_css: .credits { border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--credits) 30%, transparent); border-radius:2px; padding:8px 10px; }

themes.name: forest
themes.description: Sage green with round corners and the names on a soft green panel.
themes.extra_css: .av .names { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent); border-radius:14px; padding:12px 14px; }

themes.name: plate
themes.description: A vintage plate print: sepia paper, an italic serif name, centred between double rules.

themes.name: minimal
themes.description: Everything centred on plain paper with a light name and lots of air.

themes.name: midnight
themes.description: Always dark, by day and by night, with a soft blue accent.

themes.name: high-contrast
themes.description: Larger type, pure black on white (white on black at night), strong outlines.

study_guidance: Look at the photo or listen, think of the name, then tap Show Answer.
Tap Good if you knew it and Again if you didn't.
Anki starts you on 20 new cards a day so you're never swamped. The rest arrive day by day. That's normal, not broken.
